title: LG’s 1000Hz gaming monitor will cost $1,000.
summary: Announced in May, the 24.5-inch LG UltraGear (25G590B) is the first monitor to support a native 1000Hz refresh rate at 1,920 x 1,080 resolution. If you buy something from a Verge link, Vox Media may earn a commission.
